verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer has a dedicated data privacy practice page claiming top-tier privacy credentials ('more CIPPs than any other comparable firm,' extensive privacy policy drafting and contractual negotiation experience), which directly supports a documented privacy/cyber counsel practice. However, the evidence lacks specifics on jurisdiction-specific compliance work (GDPR, CCPA, DPDP Act) or named cyber-incident engagements. Missing for 10: explicit mention of GDPR/CCPA/DPDP Act compliance work, named privacy/cyber matters or client examples, and any cyber-incident response service description.
